Name: Eco Score
Author: maaikesww
Description:
Eco Score tracks your farm’s environmental footprint and gives you gameplay rewards based on how clean or polluted the air is.
This mod adds challenges for machine-heavy play and rewards environmentally friendly choices.
[b]
[/b][b][u]Environmental Score System[/u]
[/b]The mod constantly looks at:
[list]
[*]Polluting machines (Furnaces, Heavy Furnaces, Charcoal Kilns, Bone Mills, etc.)
[*]Eco-friendly machines (Bee Houses, Worm Bins, Solar Panels)
[*]Mature trees (positive influence)
[/list]Each object impacts the global Eco Score, which in turn affects, but never guarantees, the likelihood of obtaining higher-quality crops, fish, and forage. These RNG-outcomes are also influenced by your Farming, Fishing, and Foraging skill levels.

[b][u]Gameplay Effects
[/u][/b][b]Clean Air (high score)[/b][list]
[*]Better crop quality
[*]Better forage quality
[*]Better fish quality
[*]Increased animal friendship from petting
[/list][b]
Polluted Air (low score)[/b][list]
[*]Lower chance of high-quality items
[*]More trash catches while fishing
[*]Reduced animal friendship
[/list][b]
Neutral
[/b]Standard game behavior.

See the image for 100 cauliflowers that shows the differences between the 3 Eco Scores, the farming skill was the same and only the Eco Score has changed. The Clean Air day has more gold quality Cauliflowers than Neutral and Polluted. 

[b][u]Eco Score Menu (Press R or click on the Jumino icon)[/u]
[/b]This menu shows:
[list]
[*]Total Eco Score
[*]Clean / Neutral / Polluted status
[*]Quality chances for crops, fish, and forage
[*]Full breakdown of all contributing machines
[*]Hover over the yellow question-mark icon for an explanation of the system and a reminder which machines affect it
[/list][b][u]
Configurable[/u]
[/b]Values can be changed in config.json

[list]
[*]Score thresholds for Clean/Polluted days
[*]Score values for each machine
[*]Score per mature tree
[/list]
